item.title: FEC, MCC push ahead with next 550 Collyhurst homes
item.description: Phase two of the regeneration of the North Manchester neighbourhood would see the number of homes within a given area increased by 392. The post FEC, MCC push ahead with next 550 Collyhurst homes appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: North West Industrial & Logistics | Summary + gallery
item.description: More than 260 property professionals gathered together for the sold-out annual briefing on the sector in the region, including the latest market trends, current challenges, and future opportunities. The post North West Industrial & Logistics | Summary + gallery appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Stalled 525-flat Salford scheme on market after developer collapse
item.description: Sourced Development Group’s Regent Plaza is being marketed for sale after the SPV delivering the project went bust owing £34m to creditors and investors. The post Stalled 525-flat Salford scheme on market after developer collapse appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Spanish hotelier to transform Liverpool’s Coopers Building
item.description: Líbere Hospitality Group has signed a management agreement for the grade two-listed former department store, with plans in place to convert the property into a 148-bed aparthotel. The post Spanish hotelier to transform Liverpool’s Coopers Building appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Co-op Bank expands Manchester HQ by 15,500 sq ft
item.description: The business now occupies 45,000 sq ft across three floors at One Balloon Street. The post Co-op Bank expands Manchester HQ by 15,500 sq ft appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Starmer reiterates pledge to build Deeside Industrial Park station
item.description: With Senedd elections weeks away, the Prime Minister will today endorse Transport for Wales’ plan for the future of rail in the country, which could cost £14bn to turn into reality. The post Starmer reiterates pledge to build Deeside Industrial Park station appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Barrow’s Forum and market hall to meet wrecking ball
item.description: Aged 55, the town centre structures have reached end of life and need to be knocked down, paving the way for the site’s redevelopment as part of the Heart of Barrow regeneration project. The post Barrow’s Forum and market hall to meet wrecking ball appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: MCR Property Group launches £360m Flow Student platform
item.description: The business headed by Aneel Mussarat has set up the brand as its identity in the national PBSA market, a sector in which it already owns 6,000 student beds and is looking for more. item.title: Carpenter snaps up Liverpool PBSA opportunity
item.description: The former Ritz Roller Rink site on the corner of Mulberry Street and Myrtle Street has planning permission for 242 student flats. The post Carpenter snaps up Liverpool PBSA opportunity appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Liverpool seeks development partner for £65m heat network
item.description: “Liverpool is seizing a once‑in‑a‑generation opportunity to transform how our city is heated,” said Leader Cllr Liam Robinson. The post Liverpool seeks development partner for £65m heat network appeared first on Place North West.
